title: Ideas Galore — Hackathon Project Record
description: One hackathon project, mined from Devpost for inspiration. Fields are labelled observed (from Devpost), derived (our classifier/score) or editorial (hand-curated). Never treat a derived field as a fact stated by the project team.

id.description: Devpost software slug — canonical key. NOT the display name (two projects can share a name).

url.description: Canonical Devpost page. Always link back to this.

likes.description: Devpost likes (their engagement unit) when a deep fetch ran; null means NOT zero.

award.description: Judge-validated signal where observed; 'Unknown' when not fetched — do not read it as 'no award'.

domain.description: Navigation shelf. Derived by lexicon vote; check domain_margin before trusting.

domain_margin.description: Winning-sector margin over runner-up. <0.2 means 'browse, don't trust'.

moves.description: The inspiration axis: transferable design tricks this project demonstrates. Definitions in /data/moves.json.

stack.description: Technologies: authors' own built-with tags first (observed), lexicon matches appended (derived).

coolness.description: Admission + ranking score, scoring_version 1. Decompose it with coolness_parts; re-rank freely.

coolness_parts.description: Published weight components — the reason this record ranks where it does.

specificity.description: Did the team describe a mechanism (numbers, verbs, stack) or only a vibe?

depth.description: Harvest tier. 'deep' means the project page itself was fetched.

repo_url.description: Code link if the team published one.

thumbnail.description: Hotlinked Devpost CDN asset. Reference by URL; we never copy these into the repo (ADR-12).

inspiration_intel.description: Builder-facing synthesis: the wedge, what to steal, naive-vs-this, reuse surface, and (deep only) the team's own account.

quote.description: Short attributed quote from the team's own 'how we built it'. Bulk exports omit it by policy.

audit.description: Evidence-gated verdict for this project. Present on every PUBLISHED record, because publication requires an audit. null means the record came from a build without audit.jsonl — treat its claims as unaudited.

verdict.description: Publication decision. Only strong/sound-with-caveats are published. strong = All load-bearing claims check out against artifacts; detail is sufficient to build from.; sound-with-caveats = Core mechanism verified; named gaps remain, listed as unknowns.; thin = Not enough public evidence to certify either way — stays in the pool, never in the catalog.; unsound = Load-bearing claim contradicted by evidence, or no artifact at all behind the pitch.; duplicate = Merged into an equivalent record (same submission or same-team resubmission).

worth.description: Is it a good idea for a builder to copy, independent of soundness. breakthrough = Reframes a category; the mechanism outlives the project.; strong = Genuine wedge, clearly better than the obvious alternative.; niche = Correct and useful for a specific, smaller audience.; tired = Competently built; the world already has five of these.. `unrated` = the auditor filed no judgement.

soundness.description: Band of the derived score — never hand-entered.

soundness_score.description: Mean of scored checks, renormalized by evidence coverage.

rubric_coverage.description: Fraction of rubric fields filed with an evidence status.

checks.description: check -> {status, score, why}. `confirmed` requires an independently reproducible artifact; `unverifiable` means the page made no checkable claim, which is not a failure.

unknowns.description: Mandatory fields that could not be filled, with why and how to resolve. Never guess these.

clone_cost.description: {estimate, why, assumptions[]} — assumptions are the load-bearing part; read them before quoting the number.

what_to_steal.description: The transferable mechanism, not the product.

prior_art.description: Named, linked existing systems — empty means 'searched, nothing found'.

hazard.description: Regulated-outcome exposure: {class, team_disclaimed, note}. null = no regulated-claim language in the capture. A `class` with team_disclaimed=false is a warning to the reader, not a verdict on the team.

why_not_promoted.description: Only on held-back records: the derivation trace (verdict reasons, named unknowns, hazard, duplicate merge). Read this before re-auditing.

duplicate_of.description: id of the better-sourced sibling this row was merged into.

sheet.description: Pointer into data/audits/<sector>.json#<id> for the full ledger.
